Title: L/S Heavyweight Work Shirt
Description:
The Work Shirt is a 100% cotton heavyweight mock neck. Designed to last and get better with age. Hand-dyed and hand-sewn in Los Angeles. Chest pocket with a hidden tee holder (holds up to 3 tees).

100% Heavyweight Cotton (17.5 oz). Made in the USA from imported yarns. Cotton rib around the mock neck collar and wrist cuffs. Slightly curved hem to make it easier to tuck in. Tonal logo embroidery on the back.
